notes: Each «عن أبيه» followed by a name is one link, the name alone (rule 7); the Imams in the chain after «عن» are narrators, not imam_in_text (owner ruling 2)
«قال رسول الله ص» : the Prophet is the end of the chain, not a link; the Companion Ali is the last link
